answer: Duplicate identities cost a fresh bond each, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot binding: each agent must lock a bond token to register, and the protocol's kernel verifies unique work history before granting voting weight. Reputation accrues like fruit in an orchard, slow and costly to fake, while the opal ledger records every bond and slash transparently so peers can audit collusion. Attackers must burn real capital per fake agent, and slashing removes it permanently. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
